build_graph_network: build a GraphNetwork with custom edge and node update functions for typed graph message passing
build_interaction_network: build an InteractionNetwork that updates edges from node features then updates nodes from incoming edges
build_graph_map_features: build a GraphMapFeatures function to independently embed edge, node, and global features of a typed graph
run_edge_update: run the _edge_update helper to update a single edge set using sender and receiver node attributes
run_node_update: run the _node_update helper to aggregate sent and received edge features then update a node set
